evidence.characterization: Chronic terminal and tmux fragility on macOS arm64, amplified under CI load; not introduced by upstream PR #165 and not attributable to an fxnk carry.

evidence.coverage_gap: Upstream full-ci.yml ignores pushes to main, so merge commits are not normally exercised by Full CI.
